components.name: Signal Gate Brand Mark

components.html: RoleRadar
components.css: .ds-brand-lockup { align-items:center; color:#17201b; display:inline-flex; gap:10px; font-family:Geist,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-brand-mark { display:inline-flex; flex:0 0 30px; height:30px; overflow:hidden; width:30px; } .ds-brand-mark svg { display:block; height:100%; width:100%; } .ds-brand-name { font-size:16px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.025em; line-height:1; }

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: Compact decisive action with the product's rare lime signal.
components.css: .ds-signal-button { background:#d9ef70; border:1px solid #bcd63f; border-radius:4px; color:#18200f; min-height:40px; padding:0 16px; font:600 13px/1 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; transition:background-color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease; } .ds-signal-button:hover { background:#bcd63f; transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-signal-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #bcd63f; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Stacked Filter Field
components.description: Paper control with a compact uppercase label above the selected value.
components.css: .ds-field { background:#fbfaf6; border:1px solid #d8dbd3; border-radius:4px; display:grid; gap:2px; padding:6px 9px; } .ds-field span { color:#929a95; font:600 8px/1 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-field select { background:#fbfaf6; border:0; color:#3d4741; font:500 11px/1.2 Geist,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-within { border-color:#69736d; outline:2px solid #bcd63f; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Row
components.description: Text-first dark-rail navigation with no destination or help icons; one lime hairline marks the active row across desktop, tablet, and the mobile labeled strip.

narrative.overview:
RoleRadar looks like a focused research desk built for sorting live opportunity signals: editorial in hierarchy, operational in density, and deliberately restrained. Warm stone and paper fields keep long searches calm; dark forest panels create decisive anchors; rare lime signals mark what is live, new, or actionable.

The system earns character through alignment, information rhythm, hairlines, and compact typography rather than decorative chrome. Interface elements sit directly in the composition whenever a container adds no meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, low-glare working canvas with high-contrast forest anchors.
One rare signal color reserved for status and decisive actions.
Editorial display scale paired with compact operational metadata.
Flat surfaces, thin separators, small corners, and dense but legible rows.
Motion communicates incoming or reorganized information, never decoration.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime marks change, state, or action; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Scale Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from type size, weight, position, and wrapping before color or containers are added.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer a divider, inset line, or changed field color before adding a shadow.

dos: Do use composition, rows, dividers, and metadata as primary visual material.
Do vary density between quiet propositions and information-rich demonstrations.
Do keep product previews believable and aligned to the real listings vocabulary.
Do reserve lime for a visible state change, live signal, or decisive action.
Do make responsive reflow preserve meaning rather than merely shrink dimensions.
donts: Don't turn every content group into a rounded card or pill.
Don't introduce blue-purple gradients, glass panels, glow, or generic startup decoration.
Don't use shadows as the default boundary between regions.
Don't center every section or repeat one symmetric container rhythm.
Don't animate ornamental properties when the information itself can move, assemble, filter, or update.
